findings.description: Security agency allocated ₦31.1B for hospital construction and repairs - 46x more than Health Ministry HQ. NIA's mandate is intelligence gathering, not healthcare. This represents a severe breach of statutory functions.
findings.recommendation: Review against NIA's statutory mandate. This allocation should be under Ministry of Health or FCDA.

findings.entity: Office of the National Security Adviser
findings.description: Spending 8.5x the median for budget code 2305 (Security Equipment) compared to similar security agencies including DSS and DIA.
findings.recommendation: Compare with Defence HQ and Police equipment budgets. Request detailed procurement breakdown.

findings.description: Travel allowances increased 320% from ₦5.4B in 2025 to ₦22.49B in 2026. Total NASS budget: ₦344.85B for 469 legislators (₦735M per legislator/year).
findings.recommendation: Request itemized breakdown of travel destinations. Compare with parliamentary benchmarks in peer countries.

findings.description: Police Academy allocated ₦5.9B for school meals program - outside core policing mandate.
findings.recommendation: Clarify relationship with education sector. This should be under Ministry of Education.

findings.description: Military allocated ₦3.72B for road construction - typically Ministry of Works responsibility.
findings.recommendation: Review against Army's core mandate. Road construction should go through FERMA or Works Ministry.

findings.description: Navy allocated ₦3.64B for public school construction - education is not a military function.
findings.recommendation: Transfer to Ministry of Education or UBEC.

findings.description: Vehicle procurement costs 450% above market benchmark. Toyota Land Cruiser budgeted at ₦180M vs market price of ₦40M.
findings.recommendation: Review procurement process. Request competitive bidding documentation.

findings.description: Spy agency allocated ₦1.71B for road construction projects.
findings.recommendation: Review against DIA statutory mandate. Roads should be under Works Ministry.

findings.description: Exact ₦10B allocation for 'Road Rehabilitation' suggests estimation rather than actual engineering costing.
findings.recommendation: Request itemized breakdown with unit costs, quantities, and specific locations.

findings.description: State budget 3.2x higher than median of all 36 states at ₦4.445T. While Lagos has highest IGR, gap warrants review.
findings.recommendation: Benchmark against population-adjusted and economic output metrics.

findings.description: Only 2.27% of budget allocated to education - lowest percentage in nation. UNESCO recommends 15-20%.
findings.recommendation: Review against national education policy commitments and UNESCO benchmarks.

findings.description: NSCDC allocated ₦1.14B for public school construction - security agency doing education work.
findings.recommendation: Transfer allocation to Ministry of Education or UBEC.

findings.description: Total allocation of ₦3.15T with 76% (₦2.39T) going to personnel costs. Capital expenditure only 15%.
findings.recommendation: Review personnel-to-capital ratio. Compare with regional military benchmarks.

findings.description: Hospital repairs budget only ₦675.9M - compare to NIA's ₦31.1B for same budget code.
findings.recommendation: Health Ministry should be primary allocator for healthcare infrastructure.

findings.entity: Office of the Secretary to Government
findings.description: ₦5.2B allocated for 'Miscellaneous Expenses' - vague description for significant amount.
findings.recommendation: Demand specific breakdown of miscellaneous items.

findings.description: ₦700M for International Travel & Transport - exact round number for 26 legislators.
findings.recommendation: Request itemized travel breakdown with destinations and justifications.
